caption: The drawing features three objects arranged vertically on a plain, light-colored background. At the top is a pair of metal scissors with two circular finger holes and angled blades that appear slightly oxidized, giving them a dark grayish and brownish tone. In the middle, there is another pair of metal scissors with ornate finger holes, a more geometric and decorative handle, and pointed blades, also rendered in shades of dark gray and brown suggestive of tarnished metal. At the bottom, there is a rectangular, basin-like tray with rounded edges and a raised rim, depicted in dark brown and gray mottled tones that suggest a weathered or patinated metal surface. The artist's name, "Eugene Bartz," is written in small letters below the tray.
title: Candle Snuffer, Trimmer & Tray
